subject: general
question: Who among the following is not an Odissi Dancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darshana Jhaveri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Darshana Jhaveri**

 
 
• Darshana Jhaveri was born in **Mumbai**.
 
• Darshna Jhaveri is related to **Manipuri dance**.
 
• She learned Manipuri dance from **Guru Bipin Singh**.
 
• Later, she learned the traditional** Raslila dances** from** Sutradhari Kshetritombi Devi**, the** Nata Pung **from** Guru Meitei Tomba Singh **and traditional **Maibi Jagoi** from** Kumar Maibi**.
 
• Darshana Jhaveri received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1996** by Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• She was honored with the** Padma Shri in 2002**.
 
• She was awarded the **Kalidas Samman Award in 2018**.
